code.verdict:
The FeynRules form is the correct one for this code: UUV1 = P(3,2)+P(3,3) (= -P(3,1)), with the stored FeynRules ghost-scalar (UUS1) particle lists and couplings left unchanged. This is variant A, carried by the API line, vpvltpvw 718fe4b6 and feynkit@origin d3b91d31. vpvltpvw chose the right model, but its written reasoning is partly wrong.

eed18162 and its descendants (8ccef391, the on-shell CT tip 170773df, and main@origin ff533fcd since 45440053) are wrong because they are incomplete. Changing UUV1 to P(3,2) is correct only if a slot labelled ghX holds the ghost field c. The unchanged UUS1 lists require the opposite: that slot holds the antighost field barc. No reading of the slots makes that mix match the Faddeev-Popov (ghost) action.

The FFV1 transposition does not force a ghost transposition. Ghost labels are internal names only. The single other consistent ghost sector is C: change BOTH UUV1 (to P(3,2)) AND every UUS1 list, by the charge-preserving relabelling G described below. C gives physically the same results as A.

Reconciling the two lines means keeping A and dropping rmplzvwv's model change.
findings: VERIFIED (code). How this code assigns slots, identical on both tips and on main@origin. A vertex slot is matched to the particle ENTERING the vertex through that half-edge: the edge particle at its sink end, the antiparticle at its source end. API tip: crates/feynkit-generator/src/generation.rs:2116-2142 (available_interaction_half_edges). On-shell tip 170773df: generation.rs:3310-3362 together with vertex_half_edge at :4574-4594. main@origin ff533fcd: crates/gammalooprs/src/graph/parse/mod.rs:83-105 and :174-215. GammaLoop imports the finalized FeynKit slots without changing them (crates/gammalooprs/src/graph/parse/mod.rs:118-127).
VERIFIED (code). P(mu,i) is the incoming momentum of the half-edge in slot i: the edge momentum q with +q at a sink and -q at a source (API generation.rs:366-373; on-shell :420-426).

VERIFIED (code). Fermions follow the natural all-incoming reading. Gamma(mu,i,j) lowers to gamma(bis(slot i), bis(slot j), mink) (API generation.rs:504-509). The e- propagator numerator is i(PSlash(idx(1,2),idx(1,1)) + Me*Identity) (assets/models/json/sm/sm.json:2486-2489), where leg 1 is the source and leg 2 the sink (generation.rs:2089-2099). The Dirac indices therefore chain as vertex(slot1, h) times propagator(h, source). So FFV1 = Gamma(3,1,2) on [e+, e-, a] means psibar on slot 1, the incoming antifermion. The repo's fermion convention is the transpose of FeynRules'.

VERIFIED (history). Original FeynRules SM in uupxprkx 3ebef38a (2023-09-12): FFV1 = Gamma(3,2,1), FFV2 = Gamma(3,2,-1)*ProjM(-1,1), UUV1 = P(3,2)+P(3,3). Its ghost vertex lists V_12..V_35 and the couplings GC_3, 4, 10, 52, 53 and 70-80 are byte-identical to today's.

VERIFIED (code). Both tips give a ghost propagator of i/(P^2-M^2) (sm.json:2326-2373) and one minus sign per closed ghost loop: the Grassmann count includes ghosts (API generation.rs:1510, 1548, 1659-1677; on-shell :1602, :1669). The consistent vertex convention is therefore vertex = i x (action coefficient of the monomial barc*X*c), with no extra minus sign per vertex.

VERIFIED (mechanical derivation; sympy script at scratchpad/ghostwf/slots/scripts/fp_derive.py). I derived the electroweak Faddeev-Popov action from the repo's own bosonic conventions (on-shell audit sm-conventions-audit.typ:13-21: D = d - iK, Phi = (iG+, (v+H-iG0)/sqrt2)). The gauge-fixing functions F+- = dW+- + MW G+-, FZ = dZ + MZ G0, FA = dA follow from cancelling the vector-Goldstone mixing, and they also reproduce the model's ghost masses. Comparing against the 23 electroweak ghost vertices, under the reading 'entering ghX = antighost field barc, entering ghY~ = ghost field c' (call it L2): variant A matches 23/23 and B matches 11/23. Under the opposite reading (L1: entering ghX = ghost c): C matches 23/23, B 15/25 (all 10 G0/G+- ghost entries wrong), D 15/23, A 3/25. No reading makes B consistent.

VERIFIED (by hand). QCD uses the audit's convention R = -T^T, D = d + igR (audit line 25). Under L2, A gives V_35 = g f^{a1a2a3} P1, which matches the action. Under L1, B gives -g f^{a1a2a3} P2, which also matches. E (= -P(3,2)) has the wrong sign under either reading.

VERIFIED. The Goldstone phase used in the derivation is the one the model's own vertices imply: Phi^dagger K K Phi reproduces V_40 [a,W-,G+] = GC_74 = -e MW and V_46 [a,W+,G-] = GC_75 = +e MW (scratchpad/ghostwf/slots/scripts/vvs_check.py). Because these two conjugate couplings differ, the bosonic sector does not stay unchanged when every label is conjugated. A 'uniform conjugation' of the ghost sector by analogy with the fermion fix (variant D) is therefore inconsistent.

VERIFIED (scratchpad/ghostwf/slots/scripts/variants.py). Define G as the relabelling ghX -> (charge-conjugate X)~, i.e. ghWp->ghWm~, ghWm->ghWp~, ghZ->ghZ~, ghA->ghA~, ghG->ghG~. G preserves electric charge and flips ghost number. G(A) reproduces exactly B's 13 ghost-vector (UUV1) vertices, including V_35. On the UUS1 vertices, G(A) agrees with the stored lists only for the Higgs ones (V_17, V_25, V_34). Consequence: A and B give identical results on every ghost loop that contains no G0/G+- ghost vertex. That covers pure QCD and electroweak loops with only vector or Higgs couplings, e.g. the ghost triangles in H->gamma gamma. They differ on loops with at least one Goldstone-ghost vertex and at least one ghost-vector vertex; for the ghost part of the Z-G0 mixing, B = -A.

VERIFIED (docs). The on-shell audit (qoukurlwyxxp docs/architecture/sm-conventions-audit.typ:35-56) labels ghost slots under L1 ('cA,barcW-,W-' ...). Its action checks (line 23) cover VVS, VVSS, SSS, SSSS and VSS but never the 11 UUS1 vertices. Its numerical test (crates/gammalooprs/src/processes/cross_section/sewing_tests.rs:601-608, expecting -3i) and vpvltpvw's replacement test only evaluate the model's own formula; neither is a physics oracle.

INFERRED. The on-shell CT line's massive-quark QCD results do not depend on A versus B, because the two are an exact relabelling in QCD. Per-graph symbolic references (finalized_reference.json, per-diagram RQFT ratios in test_renormalization.rs) do change form, since G maps a ghost-loop orientation to the opposite one; totals over both orientations do not.
NOT RUN. No GammaLoop or FeynKit binary was built or executed. All conclusions come from reading the code and model data plus symbolic derivations in the scratch directory.
flaws: eed18162 and the on-shell audit (lines 29-72, 139). The argument '-barc d D c ... with the declared [ghost, antighost, vector] order it is P2' assumes the slot labelled ghX holds the field c. That is correct for the 13 derivative vertices alone, but the same assumption turns the unchanged V_14 [ghWm,ghA~,G+] and V_22 [ghWp,ghA~,G-] into barc^A G c^W couplings. Those do not exist in linear R_xi gauge, because F^A = d.A contains no scalar. Under the same assumption the 6 G0 and ghZ-ghW-G couplings have the wrong signs or assignments. The audit never included UUS1 in its action inventory. Its -3i test checks the model against itself.

vpvltpvw (API audit line 72 and the test comment). The conclusion is right but rests on two errors that cancel. (1) Under its own mapping (slot 1 = barc), c annihilates the incoming ghWp~, which has charge -1, so D c = (d + ieA) c, not (d - ieA) c. (2) With the code's one-minus-per-ghost-loop convention there is no extra per-vertex 'ordered incoming Grassmann' minus sign. Its test is also self-consistency only, as it admits. It adds no UUS1 inventory and no discriminating Ward or Slavnov-Taylor identity.

Ben's lorentz.py comment (6a7b3dcb, lines 20-22). It is correct that -P2 violates the ghost-gluon Slavnov-Taylor relation. It does not record that P(3,2) with the same couplings is an exact relabelling of P(3,2)+P(3,3) in QCD, and the claim had no test behind it.

Finding A7 (earlier reviewers). The conclusion and the UUS1 premise are correct. Its 'equivalent in pure QCD' remark is stronger than stated: it is an exact relabelling, not limited to Landau gauge or loop reflection, and it extends to all electroweak ghost loops without Goldstone-ghost vertices. So electroweak checks without Goldstones cannot decide either.

The task's lead, that the FFV1 transposition requires a matching ghost transposition, does not hold. 85018492 needed the transposition because fermion labels are physical (external states) once the reading became all-incoming. Ghost labels are internal only, and FeynRules' ghost sector is already the exact Faddeev-Popov action under the all-incoming reading with the L2 mapping. The fermion-style 'conjugate every label' version of the ghosts (D) flips the sign of all 8 Goldstone-ghost couplings. It would also flip the QCD ghost sign, because quark colour was deliberately left untransposed (R = -T^T). The valid choices are 'neither' (A) or 'both, by G' (C). Changing only UUV1 (B) is not one of them.

Earlier reviewers' summary (review_fixes.json F1). It describes the history as only main -> bbd3b611. It omits that the FeynRules form was original (3ebef38a), that it survived the 2025-08 transposition, that main had -P(3,2) from 2025-12-15 to 2026-06-16, and that main's P(3,2) dates from 45440053.

action.verdict: For this code and the model's ghost particle lists as they stand, the correct form is UUV1 = P(3,2)+P(3,3) (= -P(3,1) by momentum conservation), with the existing UUS1 particle lists left unchanged. This is the FeynRules/MG5 form that the API line keeps (feynkit bbd3b6118; vpvltpvw 718fe4b6). Lucien's rmplzvwv eed18162 (UUV1 = P(3,2), carried on the upstream on-shell line qoukurlwyxxp 170773df) is not wrong in isolation but it is incomplete. P(3,2) is the correct rule only under the other slot-to-field dictionary (slot 1 = ghost c, slot 2 = antighost cbar). That dictionary also requires 8 UUS1 edits: 2 particle-list changes and 6 coupling swaps. Without them, no dictionary makes the electroweak (EW) ghost sector consistent. The visible symptom is that the ghost-loop contribution to the Z–G0 mixing self-energy comes out with the wrong sign. The model's own ghost-scalar vertices select H1 (slot 1 = cbar, slot 2 = c): under H1, all 23 EW ghost vertices plus V_35 agree exactly with the linear R_xi (xi=1) action, including signs, with no phase freedom used. Under H2, 8 of the 11 UUS1 vertices fail. Both forms are consistent in pure QCD, so QCD checks cannot decide.
findings: CONVENTIONS ASSUMED: metric (+,-,-,-); fields ~exp(-iP.x) with P(mu,i) the incoming momentum of slot i, so d -> -iP; vertex = i x coefficient of the multilinear monomial; boson slots read as incoming (the field that annihilates the slot particle); ghost Feynman rule = i x coefficient of ubar...u, with one minus per closed ghost loop applied by the code (upstream audit line 173). The covariant derivative is D = d - iK with K = g W^a sigma^a/2 + g'B/2, A = sw W3 + cw B, Z = cw W3 - sw B, W+- = (W1 -+ iW2)/sqrt2, Phi = (iG+, (v+H-iG0)/sqrt2) (upstream audit lines 15-21). Ghosts: L_gh = -sum ubar^a dF^a, with ubar^+- = (ubar1 +- i ubar2)/sqrt2, so that ubar^+ pairs with u^+.

CONVENTIONS VERIFIED against the model's own bosonic vertices: 15 of 15 checks match exactly (VSS1 V_11/41/42/47/48/57/58; VVS1 V_40/46/52/61/64/69; VVV1 V_43/54), evaluated at random rational kinematics. Script and output: scratchpad/ghostwf/action-derivation/bosonic_check.py and bosonic_check.out. The ghost propagator is +i/(p^2-M^2) (assets/models/json/sm/sm.json, propagators section around line 2326 onward), consistent with L_gh = -ubar M u.

GAUGE FIXING from cancelling the V-G kinetic mixing, which is -(e v/2sw)(W-.dG+ + W+.dG- + Z.dG0/cw): F^A = d.A, F^Z = d.Z + xi MZ G0, F^+- = d.W+- + xi MW G+-. The ghost mass terms come out as -xi M^2 ubar u, as the propagator requires (derive.out).

MODEL DATA: the API line wzruyvvr f9dc5531 ghost vertices are V_12..V_35 at assets/models/ufo/sm/vertices.py:79-221, with couplings at couplings.py:21-329. Their particle lists and GC assignments are byte-identical to MG5 models/sm on branch 3.x (fetched copy in scratchpad mg5sm/). The only difference is the color f(3,1,2) vs f(1,2,3), which is the same by cyclicity. All 108 coupling values are identical to MG5. The upstream tip qoukurlwyxxp has identical ghost vertex lists and couplings, so the two lines differ in the ghost sector only in UUV1 (plus docs, tests and references).

DERIVATION RESULT: the action gives exactly 23 nonzero EW ghost vertices. Under H1 (slot ghX = ubar, slot ghY~ = u, with label ghWm = the W+ gauge-ghost pair u^+/ubar^+ and ghWp = the u^-/ubar^- pair), they map one-to-one onto V_12..V_34, and every coupling matches exactly with UUV1 = P(3,2)+P(3,3). Examples: V_14 (ubar^+ u^A G+) = e^2 v/(2sw) = GC_75; V_26 (ubar^- u^- A) = +ie P1 = GC_3(P2+P3); V_16 = GC_70; V_20 = GC_78. Output: derive.out, section 'reading D_O, UUV1 = FR'.

Under H2 (slot ghX = u, slot ghY~ = ubar), all 12 EW UUV1 vertices match P(3,2): the upstream table (audit lines 43-56) is arithmetically right within H2. But 8 of the 11 UUS1 vertices fail:
- V_14 and V_22 would be photon-antighost couplings, ubar^A u^-+ G+-, which vanish identically because F^A = d.A. This is convention-independent.
- V_16 and V_24 come out with the opposite sign. These are diagonal vertices, so no ghost rescaling can fix them.
- V_20, V_28, V_30 and V_32 have the wrong values.
The H2 action also requires [ghA,ghWp~,G+] and [ghA,ghWm~,G-], which the model lacks. Only the Higgs vertices V_17, V_25 and V_34 pass under both dictionaries.

THE SIGN IS FIXED: the diagonal vertices V_18, V_19, V_26, V_27 and V_35 are invariant under ghost rescalings u -> lam u, ubar -> ubar/lam. Under H1 they require -P(3,1), not +P(3,1). For QCD, the BRST relation ghost = g_eff f^{cbar,g,c} P_cbar, with g_eff = GC_10 (because V_36 = GC_10 f VVV1), gives GC_10 f(3,1,2)(-P1) under H1 and GC_10 f(3,1,2) P2 under H2. Both are self-consistent.

EQUIVALENCE MAP (derived by hand and confirmed by the H2 run): relabeling ghost labels by ghX -> anti(w(ghX)), with w swapping Wp and Wm, maps FeynRules' UUV1 sector exactly onto UUV1 = P(3,2) with unchanged lists and couplings, because GC_4 = -GC_3 and GC_53 = -GC_52. It maps UUS1 onto a different set. A consistent P(3,2) model therefore needs these edits:
- V_14 -> [ghA,ghWp~,G+] GC_75
- V_22 -> [ghA,ghWm~,G-] GC_74
- V_16 GC_70 -> GC_73, and V_24 GC_73 -> GC_70
- V_20 GC_78 -> GC_76, and V_32 GC_76 -> GC_78
- V_28 GC_77 -> GC_79, and V_30 GC_79 -> GC_77
The H1 and H2 readings cannot be told apart by the code: ghost slots carry no index structure, unlike spinor slots. Hence 'both or neither'. The fermion transposition Gamma(3,2,1) -> Gamma(3,1,2) was needed only because spinor contraction makes the fermion reading physical.

PHYSICAL CONSEQUENCE (symbolic, closed loop, so independent of the dictionary): in the one-loop ghost contribution to Z(k)-G0 mixing, summed over the ghWp and ghWm loops with equal-mass symmetric integration, the mixed model (UUV1 = P(3,2) with the current UUS1) gives -1 times the FeynRules result. FeynRules and the fully re-listed P(3,2) model give ratio +1 (zg0_mixing.py and zg0_mixing.out). Closed ghost loops with only UUV1 vertices, or with only UUS1 vertices, or whose scalar vertices are H vertices only, are identical in both forms: VV self-energies, H->gamma gamma/WW/ZZ, Goldstone self-energies and tadpoles. The affected loops are those combining UUV1 with non-Higgs UUS1 vertices: Z-G0 and W-G+- mixing, Goldstone-vector 3-point functions, and two-loop vector self-energies with ghost-Goldstone subloops.

It never checks the 11 momentum-independent UUS1 ghost-scalar vertices, which are the only data in the model that fix which slot is the ghost and which the antighost. The table then assumes H2 ('[cA,barcW-,W-]', and the 'declared [ghost, antighost, vector] order' comment in eed18162's lorentz.py) without justification. Upstream audit :72 ('-barc partial D c with D = partial - ieA gives V_26 = -ie pbar ... fixes all twelve electroweak ghost currents and the QCD ghost current') is correct arithmetic within H2 only. For this code, keep the upstream FeynRules form UUV1 = P(3,2)+P(3,3) (= -P(3,1)) and leave every UFO particle list unchanged. That is the API line's vpvltpvw / feynkit@origin form. eed18162's P(3,2) is incomplete, not wrong in QCD.

The reason does not depend on how the code reads the slots. Define the swap tau: [ghX, ghY~, B] -> [ghY, ghX~, B~]. Applied to the 13 UUV1 vertices, tau maps the set onto itself with equal couplings (V_12<->V_15 GC_3, V_13<->V_23 GC_4, V_21<->V_31 GC_52, V_29<->V_33 GC_53; V_18, V_19, V_26, V_27 and V_35 map to themselves). So moving the derivative between slot 1 and slot 2 is only a relabelling for QCD and for pure ghost-vector loops. The UUS1 ghost-scalar set is not closed under tau. V_14 [ghWm,ghA~,G+] and V_22 [ghWp,ghA~,G-] have no partner, and V_20/V_30 (GC_78 vs GC_79) and V_28/V_32 (GC_77 vs GC_76) have different couplings. That breaks the tie in favour of the reading in which slot 1 is the antighost field. So P(3,2) needs ALL UUS1 lists transformed by tau (keeping each vertex's coupling) to stay consistent in electroweak loops that contain both vertex types. Changing only UUV1 leaves those loops inconsistent.

numeric.why_discriminating:
The argument on paper:
1. The variants differ only in ghost vertices. Every non-ghost channel and the physical right-hand side are therefore common to all of them, so residual(X) - residual(A) = ghost(X) - ghost(A). I verified this channel by channel for every variant and point (summary.txt, "bosonic&physical identical to A: True").
2. B-A = -P(3,3) = -q, the incoming momentum of the vector at the ghost vertex.
   - In the photon s-channel, q.J_gamma = 0.
   - In the Z s-channel with the Feynman propagator, q.J_Z ~ MZ*J_G0 by the Z-current Ward identity, which the code's own sewing_tests.rs:461 checks. This term is proportional to m_tau times ubar gamma5 v.
   - So each ghost orientation gets L_B = L_A + lambda*L_G0exchange.
   - The model's couplings give |lambda| = 2. The numerics fix lambda = +2: B equals A with the G0-ghost coupling tripled, exactly, in every channel at every point (the A_G0x3 run).
   - ghost(B)-ghost(A) then contains (lambda^2+2*lambda)|G0 exchange|^2, which is nonzero for m_tau != 0 and vanishes at m_tau = 0.
   - At most one of A and B can satisfy the identity at such a point.
3. The same holds for W- Z through q.J_W ~ MW*J_G-. The resulting difference is not a pure rescaling of a coupling.
4. C is B with the G0-ghost couplings sign-flipped (GC_73 = -GC_70), so L_C = L_A + (lambda-2)*L_G0 = L_A.
5. D has the same neutral ghost-scalar vertices as B, so D = B in W+W-; it differs from B in W- Z (V_20/V_28/V_30/V_32).
6. E flips the vector-channel sign relative to H and G0.
7. The controls cannot decide, by construction: ZZ and H->WW only involve the Higgs ghost vertices, which are invariant under the relabelling, and P0 has m_tau = 0, where q.J_Z = 0. These controls also validate my momentum routing, propagator denominators, spin sums, Proca replacement and identical-particle averaging, because they come out exactly zero for every variant.
